meta.description: How to train each skill: fastest / balanced / AFK tracks with stages by level. XP/hr figures are estimates; items are per action (xpEach XP per action). Built by scripts/build_training.py.

stages.name: Rock crabs / Sand crabs (re-aggro every 10 minutes)
Rock crabs / Sand crabs (re-aggro every 10 minutes)
Rock crabs / Sand crabs (re-aggro every 10 minutes)

Hitpoints.label: Comes with combat training
Hitpoints.note: Hitpoints XP is a third of the combat XP you earn; train it through another combat skill.

stages.name: Any melee, Ranged or Magic combat (1/3 as much XP)
Chinning (grey chinchompas) in the Monkey Madness II tunnels
stages.note: Costs grey chinchompas: roughly 1,000 an hour.

stages.name: High Level Alchemy (fire staff)
stages.note: Profit or loss depends on the items you alch; only the nature rune is counted.

stages.name: Splashing (-65 magic bonus)
stages.note: Needs a combat level that lets you splash safely.

Prayer.label: Chaos altar (cheaper per XP)
Prayer.note: Level 38 Wilderness: bring only what you can lose.

stages.name: Chaos altar: dragon bones (50% chance to keep each bone)

Prayer.label: Lowest effort
Prayer.note: Prayer has no truly AFK method; the altar is the least demanding.

stages.name: True blood runes (Arceuus)
stages.note: No essence to buy: you mine dense essence.

stages.name: Mahogany Homes contracts
stages.note: Plank costs vary with the contract tier.

Agility.label: Lowest effort
Agility.note: Agility is never AFK; these need the least attention per lap.

Herblore.label: Potions
Herblore.note: Herblore is buy, mix, sell: the same potions are fastest and least effort.

stages.name: Nieve / Duradel tasks, bursting where possible
Giants' Foundry
stages.note: Bar costs depend on the alloy you use.

Farming.label: Tree runs
Farming.note: XP/hr is per hour of active time; each run is limited by growth time.
